name: K4RMA: Echo
source:
Pleun Jolink, the reserved frontman of K4rma.

Inigo Ureña, a flamboyant TikToker, K4rma’s #1 fan… and Pleun’s #1 hater.

Two worlds collide. Two personalities clash. Forced to spend a week together.
What should have been a nightmare quickly turned into something… unexpected.

[From [url=https://dekaloop-studio.itch.io/k4rma-echo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Pleun Jolink，K4rma保守的主唱。

Inigo Ureña，一位浮夸的TikToker，K4rma的第一号粉丝……以及Pleun的第一号仇恨者。

两个世界碰撞。两种性格发生冲突。被迫在一起度过一周。
本来应该是一场噩梦的事情很快就变成了……意想不到的事情。
